regimens.indication: Control of Blood Pressure in Severe Hypertension / Hypertensive Emergency (Repeated IV Injections)

refs.quote: INDICATIONS AND USAGE Labetalol HCl injection is indicated for control of blood pressure in severe hypertension.

Initially, labetalol hydrochloride injection should be given in a dose of 20 mg labetalol HCl (which corresponds to 0.25 mg/kg for an 80 kg patient) by slow intravenous injection over a 2-minute period. Immediately before the injection and at 5 and 10 minutes after injection, supine blood pressure should be measured to evaluate response.
Additional injections of 40 mg or 80 mg can be given at 10 minute intervals until a desired supine blood pressure is achieved or a total of 300 mg labetalol HCl has been injected.

regimens.dose_text: Initiate with 20 mg by slow IV injection over 2 minutes. Measure supine blood pressure at 5 and 10 minutes. Additional injections of 40 mg or 80 mg can be given at 10-minute intervals until target blood pressure is reached or a maximum cumulative dose of 300 mg has been given. Patients must remain supine during administration.

regimens.indication: Control of Blood Pressure in Severe Hypertension (Slow Continuous IV Infusion)

refs.quote: Labetalol hydrochloride injection 200 mg is added to 160 mL of a commonly used intravenous fluid such that the resultant 200 mL of solution contains 200 mg of labetalol hydrochloride, 1 mg/mL. The diluted solution should be administered at a rate of 2 mL/min to deliver 2 mg/min.

regimens.dose_text: Continuous IV infusion (diluted to 1 mg/mL) administered at an initial rate of 2 mg/min (2 mL/min), titrated to blood pressure response up to a cumulative maximum dose of 300 mg.

mechanism_of_action.value: Labetalol combines both selective, competitive alpha 1 -adrenergic blocking and nonselective, competitive beta-adrenergic blocking activity in a single substance. In man, the ratios of alpha- to beta-blockade have been estimated to be approximately 1:3 and 1:7 following oral and intravenous administration, respectively.
